title: Table of two-coordinate Fourier coefficients
statement: Let $g$ be the indicator of $c$ on the equally weighted set $\{a,b,c\}$, and let $\phi_0,\phi_1,\phi_2$ be its three-point orthonormal Fourier basis. As a function of a pair of indices $(a_0,a_1)\in\{0,1,2\}^2$, the Fourier coefficient of $(x_0,x_1)\mapsto g(x_0)g(x_1)$ in the product basis is $\widehat g(a_0)\widehat g(a_1)$, with $\widehat g(0)=1/3$, $\widehat g(1)=-\sqrt2/6$, and $\widehat g(2)=-\sqrt6/6$.
